points.place: 俄罗斯库尔斯克州卡利诺夫卡村
points.title: 贫困童年
points.description: 赫鲁晓夫出生于一个贫困的农民家庭，父亲是矿工，母亲是农妇。他只接受了有限的正规教育，主要依靠自学。在青少年时期，他曾在各种工厂工作，包括制革厂和金属加工厂。这段经历使他对工人阶级的生活有了深刻理解，也为他后来加入布尔什维克党奠定了基础。他在1918年加入红军，参与俄国内战，这标志着他政治生涯的起点。
points.descriptionEn: Khrushchev was born into a poor peasant family in a small village in Kursk Governorate. His father worked in a factory and his mother was a farmer. He received only limited formal education and was largely self-taught. As a teenager, he worked in various factories, including leather and metalworking plants. These experiences gave him a deep understanding of the working class, which later influenced his political career. He joined the Red Army in 1918 and participated in the Russian Civil War, marking the beginning of his political journey.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 在顿巴斯地区，赫鲁晓夫迅速在共产党内崭露头角。他积极参与工业化和集体化运动，在乌克兰的政治地位不断提升。1925年，他成为顿巴斯地区的党组织负责人。1931年，他被调往莫斯科，担任鲍曼区区委书记。1935年，他被任命为莫斯科市委第一书记，1938年成为乌克兰共产党第一书记。这一时期，他积极参与斯大林的大清洗运动，但也展现出一定的务实态度，关注当地经济发展和民生问题。
points.descriptionEn: In the Donbas region, Khrushchev quickly rose through the ranks of the Communist Party. He actively participated in industrialization and collectivization campaigns, steadily increasing his political influence in Ukraine. In 1925, he became head of the party organization in Donbas. In 1931, he was transferred to Moscow, serving as First Secretary of the Bauman District Party Committee. In 1935, he was appointed First Secretary of the Moscow City Party Committee, and in 1938, became First Secretary of the Communist Party of Ukraine. During this period, he actively participated in Stalin's Great Purge but also showed a pragmatic approach, focusing on local economic development and民生 issues.

points.title: 战时领导
points.description: 作为乌克兰共产党第一书记，赫鲁晓夫在二战期间领导了乌克兰的抵抗运动。1941年德军入侵后，他组织游击队对抗纳粹占领军。1943年，他随苏军解放基辅，并负责重建工作。战争期间，他与斯大林保持密切联系，但也目睹了战争对乌克兰造成的巨大破坏。这段经历加深了他对战争残酷性的认识，也增强了他对和平的渴望。战后，他继续担任乌克兰领导人，负责恢复地区经济和重建工作。
points.descriptionEn: As First Secretary of the Communist Party of Ukraine, Khrushchev led the resistance movement in Ukraine during World War II. After the German invasion in 1941, he organized partisan guerrilla forces against the Nazi occupiers. In 1943, he accompanied the Red Army in liberating Kyiv and was responsible for reconstruction efforts. During the war, he maintained close contact with Stalin but also witnessed the devastating impact of the conflict on Ukraine. This experience deepened his understanding of the brutality of war and strengthened his desire for peace. After the war, he continued to lead Ukraine, overseeing economic recovery and reconstruction efforts.

points.title: 权力巅峰
points.description: 1949年，赫鲁晓夫被调回莫斯科，担任莫斯科市委第一书记。1953年斯大林去世后，他迅速在权力斗争中胜出，1955年成为苏联部长会议主席，1956年成为苏共中央第一书记。在莫斯科的权力巅峰时期，他推行了一系列重要改革：1956年发表秘密报告批判斯大林个人崇拜；推动农业改革，扩大集体农庄自主权；实施住房建设计划改善民生；在太空竞赛中取得领先；推动去斯大林化运动。然而，他的政策也面临挑战，包括1956年匈牙利事件、柏林墙危机和古巴导弹危机等国际危机。
points.descriptionEn: In 1949, Khrushchev was transferred back to Moscow, serving as First Secretary of the Moscow City Party Committee. After Stalin's death in 1953, he quickly emerged victorious in the power struggle, becoming Chairman of the Council of Ministers in 1955 and First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party in 1956. During his peak of power in Moscow, he implemented several significant reforms: delivering a secret speech in 1956 denouncing Stalin's cult of personality; promoting agricultural reforms to expand collective farm autonomy; implementing housing construction programs to improve living standards; achieving leadership in the space race; and initiating de-Stalinization campaigns. However, his policies also faced challenges, including the 1956 Hungarian uprising, the Berlin Wall crisis, and the Cuban Missile Crisis.

points.title: 晚年流放
points.description: 1964年10月，赫鲁晓夫在党内政变中被推翻，被迫辞去所有职务。他被允许保留养老金和莫斯科郊外的一栋房子，但被软禁在莫斯科近郊，实际上被政治隔离。在晚年，他撰写回忆录，反思自己的政治生涯和苏联体制的弊端。尽管失去了权力，他仍然关注国内外政治发展，对苏联后来的政策变化持批评态度。1971年9月11日，赫鲁晓夫因心脏病发作去世，葬于新圣女公墓，结束了充满争议的政治生涯。
points.descriptionEn: In October 1964, Khrushchev was overthrown in an intra-party coup and forced to resign from all his positions. He was allowed to keep his pension and a house in the Moscow suburbs but was effectively placed under house arrest and politically isolated. In his later years, he wrote memoirs reflecting on his political career and the flaws of the Soviet system. Despite losing power, he continued to follow domestic and international political developments, criticizing subsequent policy changes in the Soviet Union. On September 11, 1971, Khrushchev died of a heart attack and was buried at Novodevichy Cemetery, ending his controversial political career.

appraisal.zh: 赫鲁晓夫在史学界被视为复杂的过渡性人物：他揭露斯大林时期的高压统治并推动去斯大林化，实施住房建设、改善民生，又以太空竞赛提升苏联的国际地位，其改革为后来的改革者提供了经验与教训。也有研究者指出，他的政策缺乏连贯、半途而废，古巴导弹危机等冒险举动几近引发核战争，农业改革失败导致1963年从美国进口粮食，加之他本人曾参与大清洗、作风粗鲁，损害了苏联形象。
appraisal.en: Khrushchev is seen by historians as a complex transitional figure: he exposed Stalinist repression and pushed de-Stalinization, launched housing programs to improve daily life, and boosted Soviet prestige through the space race, his reforms offering lessons to later reformers. Yet researchers also point out that his policies were incoherent and abandoned midway, that adventures such as the Cuban Missile Crisis nearly brought nuclear war, that failed agricultural reforms forced grain imports from the US in 1963, and that his own role in the purges and crude manner damaged the Soviet image.

supporter.zh: 赫鲁晓夫被视为苏联改革的开创者，他勇敢地揭露斯大林主义的黑暗面，推动去斯大林化运动，为苏联社会带来了思想解放。他关注民生问题，实施住房建设计划，改善人民生活条件。在太空竞赛中取得领先，提升了苏联的国际地位。他的农业改革和工业政策在一定程度上促进了经济发展，为后来的经济改革奠定了基础。
supporter.en: Khrushchev is regarded as a pioneer of Soviet reform who bravely exposed the dark side of Stalinism and initiated de-Stalinization, bringing ideological liberation to Soviet society. He focused on improving people's livelihood through housing construction programs and enhanced living conditions. His leadership in the space race boosted the Soviet Union's international standing. His agricultural reforms and industrial policies to some extent promoted economic development, laying the foundation for later economic reforms.

critic.zh: 批评者认为赫鲁晓夫的政策缺乏连贯性和深度，改革半途而废。他在国际关系中冒险主义行为，如古巴导弹危机，几乎导致核战争。他对斯大林大清洗的参与使他难以完全摆脱过去的阴影。他的农业改革失败导致粮食危机，1963年苏联不得不从美国进口粮食。他的个人作风粗鲁，决策常常缺乏深思熟虑，损害了苏联的国际形象。
critic.en: Critics argue that Khrushchev's policies lacked coherence and depth, with reforms abandoned midway. His adventurous behavior in international relations, such as the Cuban Missile Crisis, nearly led to nuclear war. His involvement in Stalin's Great Purges made it difficult for him to completely distance himself from the past. His failed agricultural reforms led to food crises, forcing the Soviet Union to import grain from the US in 1963. His crude personal style and often impetuous decisions damaged the Soviet Union's international image.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，赫鲁晓夫被视为一个复杂的过渡性人物，他既继承了斯大林时代的政治遗产，又开启了苏联改革的先河。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为一位粗鲁但务实的领导人，以其著名的'鞋敲桌子'事件和'我们将埋葬你们'的演讲而闻名。他的政治遗产充满矛盾：一方面结束了斯大林恐怖统治，另一方面又未能建立更开放的政治体制。他的改革为后来的戈尔巴乔夫等改革者提供了经验教训，但也显示了苏联体制改革的局限性。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Khrushchev is viewed as a complex transitional figure who both inherited the political legacy of the Stalin era and initiated reforms that paved the way for future changes. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a crude yet pragmatic leader, famous for his shoe-banging incident at the UN and his 'We will bury you' speech. His political legacy is contradictory: while ending Stalin's terror regime, he failed to establish a more open political system. His reforms provided lessons for later reformers like Gorbachev but also revealed the limitations of systemic reform in the Soviet Union.

self.zh: 无论我们做什么，资本主义国家都将被埋葬；历史在我们这边，他们将被埋葬。
self.en: Whether you like it or not, history is on our side. We will bury you.
